scope: signed INT8 row-major W and x, INT32 y; M<=32 K<=256; no requantization
compute: all implementations read identical zero-padded arrays; all loads, config, sums and stores included
e2e: scalar/RVV read original inputs; dot packs original weights and x on every call
timing: mcycle with vstart markers; no subtraction; validate dynamic ordering in new image
sampling: rotate four implementations by (first+rep+slot)%4; preserve all warmups and samples
wave: one 4x17 vdot4 call, short actual RTL VCD window, independently check products/sums
